title: karimbolea macrantha
intro: Karimbolea macrantha, commonly known as the Red Silk Floss Tree, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the family Sapindaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include promoting digestion and alleviating various health issues such as fever, inflammation, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Karimbolea macrantha include antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, making it a valuable remedy for various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
